quantize_model_mxfp4: quantize a Qwen3.5 model using MXFP4A16 quantization scheme with per-group 32 and layer ignore patterns
apply_quantization_recipe: apply a QuantizationModifier recipe targeting Linear layers with MXFP4A16 scheme and ignore patterns
offload_quantized_model: offload a quantized model to device using dispatch_model for inference
generate_text_quantized_model: generate text from a quantized model using apply_chat_template and model.generate
save_quantized_model_compressed: save a quantized model and processor to disk in compressed-tensors format with MTP tensors
